assessor.relationship: A separate AI review agent from the product implementation agent, in an AgentCAD-requested evaluation. This is not external third-party certification.
assessor.actions: Read pinned source and recorded results; independently ran headless counterexamples/targeted tests and inspected drawing images. Did not launch AutoCAD, FreeCAD or Claude and did not modify product source.

method.shared_scope: The same useful declared capabilities, implementation evidence and cumulative anchors apply to both fixed sources. No points for tool/test counts; no requirement for every industry feature or formal certification; optional features absent from the shared evaluated contract do not automatically lose points.
method.serious_defect_rule: A demonstrated serious false-success, destructive-write or permission defect caps its responsible item at 2 until fixed and retested. The same primary defect is not mechanically deducted in multiple items.
method.evidence_rule: Skips are not passes. Historical runs count only after tracing the relevant product-code boundary. Evidence of an earlier release is not silently relabeled as an exact-current result.
method.v8_rule: 31/31 is a separate execution result and is not converted into 100 source-review points.
method.meaning_of_score: A sum of bounded ordinal evidence judgments under this rubric, not a percentage of all CAD functionality, universal correctness, official rank or manufacturing certification.
method.frozen_rubric_sha256_basis: SHA256 of the LF repository blob returned by git show 290ced3033f85e1fc97611cf1c920d922524bc3a:docs/source-capability-rubric.md; not the CRLF working-tree bytes.
method.rubric_line_endings_note: Repository LF bytes define the frozen rubric. Windows working-tree CRLF bytes are separately hashed; newline-normalized contents match.

consistency_notes: The same frozen anchors and serious-false-success caps apply to both products. No point is assigned to raw tool/test counts or the user's target.
The old AgentCAD 98 / Pro 96 scorecard is preserved as historical. Pro source has not changed, but newly demonstrated verification behavior requires revising this round's judgment.

Pro F3 and C2 are separate: the former leaves old graphics after dimstyle_modify; the new C2 reproduction performs initial rendering successfully and the verifier still misreports already-rendered text.
Prior Pro extra-empty-table deduction remains excluded as an asymmetric optional-feature requirement. Unsupported extra tables receive no capability credit.

AgentCAD's earlier owner/partial-record/style/rounding/geometry and XRECORD-output-loss failures are retained and repaired under the corresponding C2 or C3 item, without mechanical duplicate penalties.
Old evidence is inherited only with an explicit code/data boundary. Changed shared serialization invalidates assumptions in otherwise unchanged consumers.

The identical initial-render DIMDEC counterexample was also found in AgentCAD 760a2c2 generic verification. C2 was capped there as well; the final score follows repair and independent same-byte replay, not an exemption for AgentCAD.
Pro's new local 93 happens to equal its historical upstream v1.6.0 self-review 93. They differ in revision, assessor, point anchors and deduction reasons, and remain separate records.

Reaching 5 requires the complete cumulative anchors, not merely documenting a limit or closing a bug. Final native, cross-interface, structurally different non-benchmark and same-version evidence supplies those anchors here.

The historical AgentCAD 98 / Pro 96 assessment and evidence ZIP were rehashed unchanged. Pro's exact source remains the same; the newly reproduced C2 failure changes this round's assessment, not the old record.

The later transparent-display and scientific-precision counterexamples invalidated AgentCAD669's100. They were assigned to responsible C2 under the same cap, and not mechanically deducted again from every downstream consumer.

The original f1 repair was insufficient; raw inherited-layer SVG and scientific-zero failures remain preserved. The final decision follows current same-byte controls, actual output checks and completed fixed-source workflows, not merely a patch or target score.

Initial independent169-test run had168 passes and a test_demo_icon path-sensitive assertion failure because 'reviewer' contains 'viewer'. Only that unchanged case was rerun under a neutral temporary root and passed; both records are retained. This is not described as a first-run all-green result.
review_limitations: The product implementation and most native run records were produced by their respective projects. This reviewer inspected source, output records, images and provenance, and independently ran the stated headless checks; it did not independently execute either native CAD application.
This is a source-and-evidence assessment of fixed revisions, not a controlled shared-host native or model/agent comparison.
A higher total under these local anchors supports only this two-product local assessment. It does not establish an upstream-approved or worldwide leaderboard position.

Both products retain explicitly bounded engineering, drawing and security behavior. Items at 5 mean the required evidence level was met within that useful contract, not that every CAD feature is implemented or every future input is correct.

AgentCAD non-decimal angular display formats are explicitly unverifiable without a unit-aware parser. General two-line angular anchor binding remains unsupported; decimal measurement/display checks and cache-independent native regeneration are separately verified.

AgentCAD drawing templates use caller-controlled placement and supplied nominal dimensions. Unspecified tolerances, hole depths, finish and manufacturing process are not inferred. No universal layout or shop-release certification is awarded.
Native witness PDFs are AgentCAD headless renderings of real AutoCAD saved/reopened/activated DXF, not output of Autodesk's PDF plot driver. Inactive viewport activation is an explicit workflow step.
Eight local skips are unavailable CadQuery cases. Installed AutoCAD and FreeCAD paths actually ran; headless CI results do not establish native CAD support on Linux/macOS.

Legacy marker recovery deliberately refuses until old writers are closed and the marker is handled manually offline. Modern OS locking/crash recovery is verified. Trusted opt-in scripts are not a hostile-code sandbox.
Effective alpha zero is rejected for required visible text. Nonzero alpha is checked for visible output; exact intermediate transparency intensity is not certified across every format.

A final local maximum, if assigned, is conditional on the bounded reviewed contract and recorded evidence. The superseded prior maximum itself demonstrates that later counterexamples can change the judgment; no universal-correctness inference is permitted.
